item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud yang gsang zor las thog gi 'khor lo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i (pas) sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas kyi byang phyogs su/ nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas/ zla tshes la rigs ldan gyi karma Dak+ki grogs bgyis shing spyan drangs pa'i/ slar bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse nas shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa bgyis so//
